meta.title: PawBot Managed Service
meta.description: Runs PawBot (the QQ chatbot) as a DSH-managed service — start/stop, status, and logs — and bundles the "Bilibili watch" plugin. All controls (status / settings / persona / tools) live in the DSH settings page; no need to open PawBot's 6185 web UI.

panel.title: PawBot Control Panel
panel.subtitle: One-click start, status, settings, and persona — all in one place. No need to open PawBot's own 6185 web UI.
